title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
slides: Jensen Huang almost lost the AI race for the US?
Nvidia's chips power nearly all advanced AI models.
But Huang once considered shifting production overseas.
Export controls now limit sales to China, reshaping strategy.
Ask: is US AI leadership secure or fragile?
thread_text:
1. The $4 Trillion Gamble

Jensen Huang built Nvidia into the backbone of the AI boom. But a single decision years ago almost sent that dominance overseas.

2. Chips Behind Every Model

Nvidia hardware powers nearly every advanced AI system today. That concentration puts enormous leverage in one company's hands.

3. The Overseas Option

Huang once weighed shifting production abroad. Had he done it, US export policy and supply chains would look very different now.

4. China Sales Cut Off

Export controls now restrict Nvidia's China business. The company is redesigning chips and rerouting strategy in real time.

5. Is US AI Safe?

Look at where the compute comes from. Ask yourself: if one supply chain broke tomorrow, what would still run?
